source: UKHSA, Tuberculosis in England 2025 report (data through end-2024). Supplementary Table 8 (per-LA 3-year-average rates) and Supplementary Table 14 (time series of notifications by country of birth in the non-UK-born population).
caveat: TB notifications are not arrivals data, they reflect a multi-year mix of cumulative country-of-birth composition. Roughly 75% of UK TB cases are in non-UK-born people. The per-LA data is a 3-year average (2022-2024) which smooths small-district volatility. Country-of-birth detail is national only, there is no published per-LA × COB crosstab for TB notifications.
